title: Northern Glade
description: Are you sick of "high pressure" games that "keep score"? Yeah, me too. But I FIXED it! I made a game where literally nothing happens, and nothing matters! I enjoy playing as a chicken, though it grants you no special powers. I'm not sure what chicken powers would be. Brief and ponderous flight? Speak to other chickens? Super fast egg warming? You can experience “Northern Glade” here: https://incompetech.com/games/Magic%20Scout/
